inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not report to licensing an incident involving inappropriate touching between two children which placed the children at risk. The incident happened on the 19th of December, and the operation reported the incident to licensing on the 22nd of December
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The operation was aware of a child inappropriately touching other children in the past, and due to lack of supervision it resulted in another incident of inappropriately touching.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: It was determined that a caregiver used prohibited punishment by pushing a child during discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: The operation failed to notify CCR of a communicable disease within the 48-hour required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant C classroom was over ratio by 4 children.  There were 9 children with one caregiver.  The specified age group was 12   17 months, which only allows for 5 children.    The preschool classroom was over ratio by 3 children.  There were 14 children with one caregiver.  The specified age group was 2 years, which only allows for 11 children.    Note:  The children were moved around in order to come into compliance with ratios.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not follow written feeding instructions that were provided by the parent.  Cereal was added to the child's bottle without the parent's knowledge or permission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver only had 11 of the required 24 clock hours of training for the previous training year available for review at the time of the inspection.  (Note: The caregiver will need to make-up the training hours.  The make-up hours will not count towards the current training year)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: A monthly playground checklist has not been completed since the month of April.  (Note:  Inspections are being conducted but have not been documented)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three of the ten children's records evaluated did not have a health statemetn on file.
Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram: Three classrooms (preschool, preschool discovery, and pre-k) did not have an emergency evacuation diagram posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Three infants did not have current written feeding instructions on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver did not have training in the following topics:    (1) emergency preparedness    (2) Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases,   (3) Administering medication   (4) Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction   (5) Understanding building and physical premises safety   (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation, it was determined that caregivers were unaware of injuries a child sustained while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a current certification form showing recalls have been reviewed.    (Note: The director corrected this during the inspection when the form was completed & signed.  The form is now available for review.)
Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection on file. The last fire inspection was completed 2/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The following hazards were observed:    1.  There was a bottle of disinfectant spray sitting on the toilet in the toddler classroom accessible to children.    (Note:  The caregiver moved the chemical and put it in a cabinet that was inaccessible to the children.)     2.  There were pieces of a broken toilet tank cover on the floor in one of the preschool restrooms.    (Note:  This was removed during the inspection.)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted in the toddler classroom.     (Note: The diagram was posted during the inspection.)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: It was determined that on more than one occasion, infant children have remained in a restrictive device for more than the 15 minutes allowed by the Standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Incident/Illness Form: Incident reports were not available for review at the time of the inspection.
